subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers split this into a heartbeat wake precedence fix first, or also change Telegram DMs away from the documented default main-session behavior?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path violates the documented `heartbeat.session` override, while changing default Telegram DM routing would alter documented compatibility behavior for existing users.

options.title: Split Heartbeat Precedence First
options.body: Adopt or replace the heartbeat wake fix so configured `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram default DM routing controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram Isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default as part of this issue, accepting the upgrade and docs impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer To Heartbeat Entries
options.body: Hold the fix behind native per-session heartbeat scheduling, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split Heartbeat Precedence First
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the heartbeat wake fix so configured `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram default DM routing controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the implicated routing files makes this the best available owner for a compatibility-sensitive split/adopt decision.
